rows.label: Rank 4 (Hot & Fresh)
rows.note: needs Liked chemistry with all six members and The Hex Finale

conditions: Hex Treasures cannot exceed the daily standing cap; there is no banking them past it.
Rank 4 needs Liked chemistry (90 points, 4 dialogues) with all six KIM members, and chemistry itself is rank-gated: Friendly needs syndicate Rank 2, Liked needs Rank 3, so you cannot front-load it.
bonuses: Buy every KIM gift as soon as it's affordable; Höllars are just credits, so cost is never the obstacle to chemistry.

disclosures.title: the full rank ladder
disclosures.body: Rank 1 Leftovers: 5,000 standing, 10,000cr, 15 Efervon Sample, 15 Hollvanian Pitchweave Fragment. Rank 2 Fresh Slice: 22,000 standing, 25,000cr, 5 Experimental Arc-Relay, 12 Entrati Obols, 25 Pitchweave. Rank 3 2-For-1: 44,000 standing, 50,000cr, one of each six 750-value Hex Treasures. Rank 4 Hot & Fresh: 70,000 standing, 100,000cr, 25 Techrot Chitin, 25 Necracoil, 40 Efervon Sample. Rank 5 Pizza Party: 99,000 standing, 200,000cr, 5 Techrot Motherboard, one of each six 750-value Treasures again. Two sacrifices (Entrati Obols, Necracoil) come from Albrecht's Laboratories on Deimos, so Whispers in the Walls access is a soft prerequisite.

conditions: Component blueprints are consumed per craft: the weapon needs 2 Blades and 2 Hilts, so each component blueprint is bought twice (20,000 standing), not once.
bonuses: Spend your free Rank 5 vendor item on the 15,000-standing main blueprint; it's the priciest thing Minerva sells.

A friend already at Rank 5 can trade you the built Blade/Hilt components directly: the blueprint and finished weapon are untradeable, but the built components are not. Saves 20,000 standing and the resources; you still need Rank 5 yourself for the main blueprint.
